mammamiradio_url.label: Mamma Mi Radio URL
mammamiradio_url.description: Full HTTP(S) base URL of your Mamma Mi Radio HA addon. The default works when Music Assistant and the addon run on the same Home Assistant host; remote or custom deployments need a reachable URL. Do not include an admin token.

errors.invalid_base_url: Invalid Mamma Mi Radio URL. Enter a full HTTP(S) base URL with a hostname, for example http://localhost:8000.

manifest.description: AI-generated Italian radio station — continuous music, banter, and ads. Self-hosted via the Mamma Mi Radio HA addon.
